description: Shared BED-parsing contract between the engine's harness/validate_bed.py and the web form's strhub-web/lib/verified/validate-regions.ts. Both must agree on which files parse and to what rows: a BED accepted in the form and rejected here aborts a run with no report, which is a far worse failure than being told about it in the form. This file is duplicated verbatim in strhub-web/lib/verified/bed-cases.json; each side asserts the copies are identical when both checkouts are present.

cases.name: chr prefix added when the file omits it
comment, track and browser lines ignored
cases.bed:
# a note
track name=x
browser hide all
chr1	100	200

cases.name: extra columns ignored, column 4 taken as the name (HipSTR/GangSTR layouts)
a period in column 4 is not a name
empty file yields no rows rather than an error
header row skipped (STRsearch ref bed)
cases.bed:
Chr	Start	End	Period	Reference allele	Marker	STR sequence structure	Stand
chr1	7442891	7442934	4	11	Marker1	D1GATA113	+
chr21	20554291	20554417	4	29	Marker2	D21S11	+

cases.name: a single data row is not mistaken for a header
coordinates located when they are not in the first three columns
BED convention wins when two layouts would both parse
end before start is an error, not a reason to relocate the columns
fewer columns than the located layout needs
